name: Blight

targets.description: a creature you can see, or a nonmagical plant

summary: Con save or 8d8 Necrotic, half on a success; Plant creatures fail automatically.
text: A creature you can see within range makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. A Plant creature fails the save automatically. Alternatively, you can target a nonmagical plant that isn't a creature, such as a tree or a shrub; it makes no save and simply withers and dies. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4.
